action:
After a standard system update you need to restart any running Java
applications to make all the necessary changes.
description:
Kai Aizen discovered that the Networking component of OpenJDK 21 did not
correctly handle user authentication. A remote attacker could possibly use
this issue to leak sensitive information. (CVE-2026-61308)

It was discovered that the JSSE component of OpenJDK 21 did not correctly
handle user authentication. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service. (CVE-2026-70907)

It was discovered that the Security component of OpenJDK 21 did not
correctly handle user authentication. A remote attacker could possibly use
this issue to leak sensitive information. (CVE-2026-60589)
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in OpenJDK 21.
title: OpenJDK 21 vulnerabilities
